transcript:
leo: Heads-up — onboarding tiny-llama-3 from HF. convertcli failed after fetch with missing weight keys + chat template lost special tokens. Repro below, need eyes.

convertbot: :gear: started convert job 1749991234 for repo tiny-llama-3 (ref=main)
leo: steps:
1) hf_hub_download index.json (branch=main)
2) download shards listed in index
3) run convert -> safetensors -> Redwood format

leo: logs:
```
INFO: fetched index.json (200) size=3.2KB etag="abc123"
INFO: downloading shard safetensors-0002-of-0004 (url=https://cdn.hf.co/…/0002)
WARN: shard 0002 returned 200 but size=512 bytes (expected ~234MB)
ERROR: weight keys mismatch: missing keys ['transformer.h.10.attn.k_proj.weight', 'lm_head.weight']
ERROR: tokenizer special token <|system|> not found in tokenizer.json
ERROR: chat_template resolved to empty system message
```

maria: @leo ugh, sounds like the CDN returned a partial/truncated shard. we've seen index vs shard propagation races — index updated to reference new split-shards before all shards propagated.

aj: right. typical pattern: index.json on origin updated, CDN serves new index quickly but shard objects still warming up. If you download branch refs (main) instead of commit sha you can hit that window.

leo: i tried `--no-cache` on the index fetch, still got the small file for 0002. curl shows `Content-Length: 512` and `Accept-Ranges: bytes` but then connection closed.

sam: can you paste the index.json `sha`? maybe the repo switched to 8 shards recently.
leo: index.json top fields:
```
"_sha": "f8a2b9d...",
"safetensors": ["safetensors-0000-of-0004", "safetensors-0001-of-0004", "safetensors-0002-of-0004", "safetensors-0003-of-0004"]
```

convertbot: :warning: convert job 1749991234 failed after 3 retries — recorded in convertlogs/1749991234.log (link)

jen: we should improve downloader: when index lists shards, fetch each shard and verify its checksum/size from index metadata before accepting. if a shard is truncated or size mismatches, re-fetch the index and retry (backoff with jitter).

aj: agreed. additional guard: if using branch name, fetch the commit sha from refs/heads/main and pin downloads to that sha's tree (or use ?revision=sha via hf api). that avoids index/sha mismatch windows.

maria: also surface a clearer user message: "incomplete shard download — possible HF CDN propagation race; try pinning to commit sha or retry with --no-cache". current missing-key error is too opaque.

leo: workaround that worked for me: pinned to commit `f8a2b9d...`, `convertcli --revision f8a2b9d --no-cache --max-retries 10`, succeeded. no truncation after pin.

sam: can we add a quick health-check in onboarding docs: check each shard size > 1MB and content-md5 present, else fail early.

jen: i'll open a small PR to convertcli to add these checks + more actionable error text. also adding logging of shard ETag and index ETag so we can triage fast.

convertbot: :thumbsup: created issue INF-482: "convertcli: guard against truncated shards & index/shard propagation races" with logs attached (https://git.redwood.internal/convert/INF-482)

maria: Thanks @leo for the detailed logs. once PR lands we should retry the tiny-llama-3 onboarding and update runbook with pin-to-sha recommendation.

leo: thanks all. leaving here the curl snippet that showed the truncation for 0002:
```
curl -v -o shard-0002.part "https://cdn.hf.co/models/tiny-llama-3/safetensors-0002-of-0004" 
# -> HTTP/1.1 200 OK
#    Content-Length: 512
#    Content-Range: bytes 0-511/234567890
# connection closed by peer
```

sam: we should also consider a verifier step after assembly: check expected total param count vs model config. if mismatch, abort and delete assembled artifact.

leo: added that to the checklist. I'll re-run pinned conversion and report back.
